subs.text: Breaker 1-9, anybody westbound on 80 near mile marker 113?
Yeah, I'm about ten miles back. What you got, driver?
There's a lady on the shoulder. Barefoot. White dress. Just waving at trucks. Three in the morning.
Don't stop. I'm serious. Don't you stop.
Come on, she's somebody's daughter. I'm pulling over.
Listen to me. My buddy stopped for her last winter. Right there at 113.
They found his rig. Engine running. Door open. Never found him.
Well, she's walking up to my door now. She's smiling. Hold on.
Hey... why is she... her feet aren't touching the ground...
Driver? Driver, you there? Come back! Come back!

cards.text: HIS TRUCK WAS FOUND\NAT MILE MARKER 113
